name: Avatar
description: User identity display with image and fallback initials

name.description: User name (used for initials fallback and alt text).

icon.description: Icon content shown when no image is available.

fallback.description: Custom fallback content when image is unavailable.

children.description: Custom media content. Rendered inside the clipped avatar circle when no image is available.

fallbackDelayMs.description: Delay in ms before showing fallback (gives image time to load).

aria.nativeElement: Root is a container with no ARIA role. The `image` part is a native whose accessible name comes from the `name` prop applied as `alt`.
notes: Accessible name is provided by `name` (rendered as the image `alt` and used to derive the initials fallback). The component does not accept or apply an `aria-label`.
When the image is unavailable, the fallback (initials, `icon`, or custom `fallback`/`children`) is shown as visible text.
Avatar uses shared control geometry for compact identity chips.
Fallback initials are generated by the avatar machine; custom fallback content should remain icon/text sized to the same control box.
